selection_basis: The first four actionable records emitted by the canonical review queue after claim cleanup batch one completed and before any batch-two rewrite was applied.

observed_initial_queue.blocked_reason: The higher-priority preview consisted of sensitive or restricted records requiring actual-source and safety review rather than automatic practical rewriting.

guardrail: This batch records editorial rewrites, not scientific review. No entry is promoted to reviewed and no source is added merely to preserve inherited wording.

entries.decision: Remove unsupported survey ranges, volunteer outcomes, immediate-effect claims and rigid observation targets. Preserve an observation-first check that separates facts from human-like interpretation, adds a system-specific alternative and keeps uncertainty visible.

Remove fabricated trials, laboratory ranges, regret reduction, hiring outcomes and savings claims. Preserve a stable-criteria protocol that assesses each option independently before comparison and checks whether presentation order defined the standard.

Remove fabricated tests, financial action rules, arbitrary confidence and sample thresholds, and adherence claims. Preserve a bounded check for whether earlier outcomes can alter the next event, followed by a pre-defined stop or decision rule.

Remove unsupported mistake reduction, conversion examples, sample prescriptions, statistical precision and fabricated work scenes. Preserve an inclusion-rule check that names excluded and missing cases and keeps conclusions within the group the data can represent.
